about.label: Who's behind it
about.quote: Every tip comes from real experience. Not from a catalogue, not from a press release — from what actually works with kids.
paras: I'm a mum of three and I've been exploring Prague with children for more than 15 years. Knowing where to go isn't enough — what matters is that kids actually notice the city and enjoy it.

Pražské zkratky started more than five years ago, grew without any public funding and stands mainly on parents' recommendations. Thousands of people visit it every month. This English edition brings the same tested tips to families visiting or living in Prague: manageable routes, places where kids last, minimum pointless transfers and maximum time together.

break.text: The less time you spend searching, the more time you have with your kids.

newsletter.text: Once a month: a hand-picked list of family events, walks and places where you can save. Free, so you don't have to keep searching where to go.
